title: The Merit Order (2026)
description: Start at milestone 2, one game-year in: the CO2 price jumps to 60 €/t mid-year and the coal/gas merit order flips under you. Hold the cost line without shedding load.

economy._rationale: C1 fixture value: enough to operate, not enough to ignore the cost axis — C2's balancing pass re-derives it with the milestone's cost tiers.

_why_start_day: The first mid-campaign recipe (C1/C2): 11.9 gives 0.1 day (~2.4 h) of UNGRADED settle before milestone 2's window opens at 12 — a recipe start is a legal COLD start (the engine boots on the authored startup profile against day-11.9 evening demand), and the settle transient sheds UFLS stage 1 on the way in (measured, C2 run 1); the M1 pattern (ungraded free-play before the graded exam) applies. The day-18 first_ratchet era boundary lands inside the window; the clock moves before the campaign arms, so the era script applies at the recipe's day.
